name: B2B Customer Approval Backstop - Hold Unauthorized Semi-Custom Orders
description: Automatically holds fulfillment and alerts Logan if an order containing semi-custom products is placed by a customer without the 'b2b-approved' tag.

params.reason_notes: Unauthorized wholesale purchase: customer does not possess the b2b-approved tag.

params.subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] Unauthorized B2B Order {{order.name}} Held for Review
params.body:
Hi Logan,

Order {{order.name}} was placed containing semi-custom items by a customer who has NOT been approved for wholesale purchasing:

Customer: {{order.customer.displayName}} ({{order.customer.email}})
Order Total: {{order.totalPriceSet.shopMoney.amount}} {{order.totalPriceSet.shopMoney.currencyCode}}

Fulfillment has been automatically placed on HOLD.

Please check the B2B Approval Portal to verify whether this customer has an active wholesale application:
http://localhost:3000/#applications

- Business Bricks Automation
